lines.text: در ناحیه مغرب و موت در ان بلاد و مضرت رسیدن بکتاب و ارباب نفوس و اندوه علماء
lines.en: in the western region, and death in those lands, and harm reaching books and the masters of souls, and the sorrow of scholars,

lines.text: و ارباب دیوان و رنج تجار و اهل بازار و بودن اراجیف و رعد و برق و بادهای تند
lines.en: and the masters of the divan, and the suffering of merchants and the people of the bazaar, and the existence of rumors, and thunder and lightning, and strong winds,

lines.text: و اظهار سخنان بیهوده و بدی هوا و خیانت و حیلت در مردم و شکست یافتن کاروانها
lines.en: and the expression of vain words, and the badness of the air, and treachery and deceit among the people, and the defeat of caravans,

lines.text: و تلف شدن مالها اگر مریخ مستعلی باشد مرگ فرزند پادشاهی و بیماری خوف و
lines.en: and the destruction of wealth. If Mars is ascendant, the death of a king's child, and the disease of fear, and

lines.text: ترس در بلاد و عز و اهل خوزستان با مردم بادیر و هلاك آنمردم و اگر عطارد مستعلی
lines.en: fear in the lands, and the glory of the people of Khuzestan with the people of Badir, and the destruction of those people. And if Mercury is ascendant,

lines.text: بود صلاح حال مردم روم باشد و حریق در ناحیه عرب و کثرت باران و رعد و امکان
lines.en: it will be the improvement of the condition of the people of Rome, and fire in the Arab region, and an abundance of rain and thunder, and the possibility of

lines.text: زلزله (و اگر در دلو بود) دلالت کند بر جنگ و بانك میان مردم و خواست از عیب
lines.en: an earthquake. (And if it is in Aquarius) it indicates war and shouting among the people, and the desire for fault,

lines.text: و ظلم و ستم بر اهل حرفه و تهمت و غمز میان مردم و ظهور خائنان و نمامان و اندوه علماء
lines.en: and oppression and tyranny against the people of trades, and accusation and slander among the people, and the appearance of traitors and talebearers, and sorrow for the scholars,

lines.text: و تجار و بد گشتن هوا و سرما در وقت و هلاك اهل سواحل از ولایت عرب و مرگ پادشاه
lines.en: and merchants, and the worsening of the weather and cold in time, and the destruction of the people of the coasts from the Arab province, and the death of a king

lines.text: یا یکی از ارکان دولت و کثرت جدال و قتال و فتنه در اکثر بلاد و کثرت مرض و موت
lines.en: or one of the pillars of the state, and an abundance of dispute and killing and sedition in most lands, and an abundance of disease and death,

lines.text: و گرانی و بیماری نم و رطوبت اگر مریخ مستعلی بود مرگ در زمین فارس شیوع یا
lines.en: and dearth, and the disease of dampness and moisture. If Mars is ascendant, death will spread in the land of Fars, or

lines.text: و افتادن فتنه و اگر عطارد مستعلی بود بیماری جدل بود و افتادن مرگ در مردم و
lines.en: the falling of sedition. And if Mercury is ascendant, it will be the disease of dispute, and the falling of death among the people, and

lines.text: کثرت باد (مقارنه عطارد و مریخ در مثلثه ابی) دلالت کند بر فساد کشتیها
lines.en: an abundance of wind. (The conjunction of Mercury and Mars in the watery triplicity) indicates the corruption of ships,

lines.text: و افتادن اراجیف و برخواستن بخارات و تاریکی و بیماریها از سستی اعصاب
lines.en: and the falling of rumors, and the rising of vapors and darkness, and diseases from the weakness of nerves,

lines.text: و نکبت زنان و رطوبت دماغ و ظلم و خواست تهمت و غمز و فساد ابها و کاریزها
lines.en: and the misfortune of women, and the moisture of the brain, and oppression, and the desire for accusation and slander, and the corruption of waters and qanats,

lines.text: و رعد و برق و هلاك حیوانات ابی و رفتن بادها و ابرهای مختلف و پراکندگی
lines.en: and thunder and lightning, and the destruction of aquatic animals, and the going of various winds and clouds, and the scattering of

lines.text: مسافران و بازرگانان و زحمت وکلا و متصرفان (اگر در سرطان بود دلالت
lines.en: travelers and merchants, and the trouble of deputies and possessors. (If it is in Cancer, it indicates

lines.text: کند بر دزدیها و خیانتها در بحرها و بیماری اراجیف و دروغ و مسدود شدن راهها
lines.en: thefts and treacheries in the seas, and the disease of rumors and lies, and the blocking of roads,

lines.text: و دست برآوردن قاطعان طریق و فساد کشتیها و سستی اعصاب و ظهور غمازان
lines.en: and the raising of hands by highway robbers, and the corruption of ships, and the weakness of nerves, and the appearance of talebearers,

lines.text: و زراقان و بد گشتن هوا و سختی تجار و اهل بازار و و با و کثرت موت در مشرق و
lines.en: and hypocrites, and the worsening of the air, and the hardship of merchants and the people of the bazaar, and cholera, and an abundance of death in the east, and

lines.text: قتال میان ملوك و اضطراب عوام و خرابی املاك و شدت حرارت و قلت میاه و
lines.en: killing among kings, and the agitation of the common people, and the ruin of properties, and the intensity of heat, and the scarcity of waters, and

lines.text: فساد در مجلس پادشاه و امراء و قلت فوائد کتاب و موت در میان اهل قلم و کثرت
lines.en: corruption in the assembly of the king and emirs, and the scarcity of the benefits of books, and death among the people of the pen, and an abundance of

lines.text: فسق اغلام اگر مریخ مستعلی بود حرب و فتنه بسیار باشد و خرابی شهرها و سختی گرما
lines.en: the debauchery of youths. If Mars is ascendant, there will be much war and sedition, and the ruin of cities, and the hardship of heat.

summary.headline: Mercury–Mars Conjunction Omens
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the conjunction of Mercury and Mars, covering its effects when placed in Aquarius, the watery triplicity, and Cancer, including war, disease, weather, earthquakes, maritime corruption, famine, and political unrest. The text gives separate outcomes when Mars or Mercury is ascendant and names Rome, Khuzestan, Badir, Fars, and the Arab region.
